definitions.explanation: Marks the following item in a sequence of actions, steps, or speakers. Neutral in register and very common in instructions, presentations, and written explanation.

definitions.gloss: secondly; second (in rank or order of importance)
definitions.explanation: Introduces the second item in an enumeration, typically after まず (first). Also used with に in the pattern 〜の{次|つぎ}に to mean "after ~" or "second to ~".

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧、{次|つぎ}に⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炒|いた}めます→炒める：01879_itameru⟧。
examples.english: Cut the vegetables, and next fry them in oil.

examples.japanese: ⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧し、{次|つぎ}に⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{手順|てじゅん}→手順：05452_tejun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧いきましょう。
examples.english: First let me explain the overall flow, and next we'll look at the detailed procedure.

examples.japanese: ⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧、{次|つぎ}に⟦{使|つか}いやすさ→使いやすさ：30369_tsukaiyasusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: First price, and secondly ease of use, are what matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{琵琶湖|びわこ}→琵琶湖：29592_biwako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{次|つぎ}に⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: This lake is the second largest after Lake Biwa.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧で、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{次|つぎ}に⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think health matters more than anything, and next comes time spent with family.

notes:
The noun ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧ with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. As a sentence connector it usually stands at the head of the clause and is often paired with ⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧ (first) and ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (last).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧〜、{次|つぎ}に〜: first ~, next ~
- {次|つぎ}に⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to move on to the next thing
- {次|つぎ}に⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: the second largest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: and then — conversational, and links events loosely rather than numbering steps
- ⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: continuing on, next — slightly more formal, common in announcements and broadcasts
- ⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧: next time — about the next occasion, not the next item in a list
